title: The Sovereign Edge
style: rock, synthwave, cyberpunk, industrial, anthem, rai, industrial, light, clean, punk
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Water boiling on the stove
Steam rises high
Pork buns in the basket
Check the domain sky
Porkbun console open
Twenty dollars on the line
No multilingual gaslight games
Standard words align
Clear the cart down to the bone
Drop the high renewal traps
We are building out an empire
Rewriting backend maps
Three hundred forty active names
Matrix solid and secure
But we need a brand new gateway
Clean resilient and pure

[Chorus]
Oh we're routing through the endpoint
Firing up the script
Anthropic burned our tokens
But the safety wall was ripped
Now the local models planning
Hermes running in the night
Coreyai.dev is shining clear
Under neon crimson light
Keep the genius keep the thunder
Let the server nodes ignite
Sovereign on our own VDS
We claim the binary night

[Verse 2]
Sai is talent Rai is lightning
Flash across the screen
Jai is victory in the matrix
Purest strings you've seen
Tai is supreme foundational power
Locking in the zone
But save a special corner
For the favorite fish we own
Tai.fish is swimming home
A clean Japanese bream
Wired straight to Cloudflare DNS
A local developer's dream
Forwarded.dev is live
Ngix.app is tight
Thirty-seven dollars maxed
And the credit card cleared right

[Chorus]
Oh we're routing through the endpoint
Firing up the script
Anthropic burned our tokens
But the safety wall was ripped
Now the local models planning
Hermes running in the night
Coreyai.dev is shining clear
Under neon crimson light
Keep the genius keep the thunder
Let the server nodes ignite
Sovereign on our own VDS
We claim the binary night

[Outro]
Nine new seasonal assets locked
Sitting in the box
Nginx reverse proxy up
Security on the blocks
No more cloud API bleeding
No more billing loops to dread
Zero temperature
Deterministic builds ahead
The matrix is solid Corey
The system is fed
